title: IntelEngine — NPC Autonomy & Faction Politics
tagline: Give Skyrim’s NPCs agency: tasks, schedules, autonomous stories, and faction politics.
description:
**IntelEngine** gives Skyrim's NPCs the ability to act autonomously through SkyrimNet. NPCs can travel, deliver messages, fetch or escort people, schedule meetings and tasks, spread gossip, pursue personal storylines, and participate in an evolving faction-politics system.

**3.8** makes NPCs far more dependable: stuck NPCs recover out of your sight, tasks finish across cells and visits end on their own. Settings are on SkyrimNet's plugin settings page, and running tasks show on its Package Manager page, where Remove cancels them. Optional **Magelight UI** popups; faction politics with war rules, lasting truces and an experimental Political Engine bridge (off by default).

**3.8.3** fixes a 3.8.2 bug where a new game could get stuck at start-up, lets NPCs travel to SkyrimNet's Named Places, stops NPCs who escort you from walking off toward a stranger, and brings back Sparks bolts and children's errands.

## 🧊 **Fixing a save stuck on 3.8.2.**
Remove IntelEngine from the save and add it back, so it starts fresh. IntelEngine's own data for that playthrough resets (settings, tasks, political history, NPC facts); SkyrimNet's memories and the rest of the game are untouched. Back up the save first, and save under a new name at every step.

1. Load the stuck save, save under a new name, and quit Skyrim.
2. Disable IntelEngine in your mod manager.
3. Load the new save, let it finish loading, save under a new name again, and quit.
4. Open that save in ReSaver (FallrimTools). Filter → Show unattached instances and Show undefined elements, delete the IntelEngine entries, then File → Save As a new name.
5. Enable IntelEngine 3.8.3 (not 3.8.2, which can get stuck again).
6. Load the cleaned save and wait about a minute; the dashboard and MCM work again.

Still stuck? Type `dps` in the console, quit, and send `Documents/My Games/Skyrim Special Edition/Logs/Script/Papyrus.0.log`.

## ⚠️ **Upgrading from a pre-3.6 save? Convert it before loading with 3.8.**
Since 3.8.2 the converter is a separate download: Saves already on 3.6 or newer and fresh games don't need it. IntelEngine settings now belong to the installation, not to one save: the first time an older save loads, its settings are written to the shared settings file.

3.8 tested on **Skyrim SE/AE 1.6.1170**. 1.7.104 and **VR 1.4.15 should work** but were not retested for 3.8. Skyrim 1.5.97 partly tested by users. Use the matching versions of **SKSE and Address Library**.

## 🐛**Have issues?** Report them on the IntelEngine-GamePlugin GitHub issues page.

**Requires SkyrimNet Beta 27 or newer. Not compatible with Beta 26 or earlier.** The Package Manager row needs a SkyrimNet build with the package manager; older builds skip it. Travel to Named Places needs SkyrimNet v1.0.0-rc1 or newer; with older builds it is off. Optional: Magelight UI 1.7.1+ for the dashboard and popups.

Created by **Galanx**. 3.8 was developed by **Galanx** and **PhospheneOverdrive**, with a natural-language time parser by **Lanosity**. Thanks to **gazaret** for the 3.8.3 escort fix.
author: phospheneoverdrive
changelog:
- A new game no longer gets stuck at start-up (a 3.8.2 bug: the dashboard said "settings not available" and the MCM page froze). A save that already got stuck stays stuck after updating; see "Fixing a save stuck on 3.8.2" in the description.
- NPCs travel to SkyrimNet's Named Places. SkyrimNet already offered them to the AI as destinations ("Kitchen"), but IntelEngine could not find them, so an NPC sent to one went nowhere or somewhere else. A Named Place is now matched by its exact name first. Needs SkyrimNet v1.0.0-rc1 or newer.
- NPCs that escort the player no longer walk off toward a stranger. Asked "take me to …", the AI sometimes picked the escort action with you as the one to escort; IntelEngine then looked for an NPC by your name and could pick another character whose name contains yours (such as a summoned "Shadow <your name>"), anywhere on the map, and the task got stuck. Now the NPC travels to the place instead: go along and you arrive together, or they wait there for you.
- Sparks bolts are visible again.
- Children run errands again; carriage drivers are still never sent.

Install the whole package over 3.8.0, 3.8.1 or 3.8.2; saves and settings carry over. The DLL and five scripts changed; the ESP is unchanged. Requires SkyrimNet Beta 27+.

Thanks to @gazaret for the escort fix & @LouisCCW for helping isolate the save issues with 3.8.2!
